_source.describes: The Wizard Towers generator: its four axes, and what each die in the stack makes of a floor.
_source.status: Unofficial. Not affiliated with Games Omnivorous.
_source.rationale: The stack of d6s with a d4 balanced on top is FLAIL!'s procedure and is implemented faithfully, which the Third Party Licence permits. All entries are written from scratch for this project, not transcribed or paraphrased from the book. Each axis has 24 entries, indexed over the full table independently of the nominal d10. Ordinary floors remain a six-row table read by a d6; the top floor reads its own four-row table because the d4 is a different die, not a shorter d6. Floor descriptions are deliberately neutral so repeated rolls can sit together in one tower.
